actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.getAllApps.description: Retrieves all the applications created by the authenticated user.
actions.getTask.description: Retrieves the result of a specific Flipando application task by its task ID.
actions.getTask.props.task_id.descriptio: ID of the task to be retrieved.
actions.runApp.description: Triggers the execution of a specific Flipando application by ID, initiating a background job for application completion.
actions.runApp.props.application_id.desc: ID of the application to be completed.
actions.runApp.props.file.description: File to be uploaded, if the application requires documents. Supports PDF, DOCX, images, and other document formats.
actions.runApp.props.file_description.de: Description of the file being uploaded. Required when uploading a file.
actions.runApp.props.inputs_data.descrip: JSON string of key-value pairs for application input variables.
actions.runAppGenerator.description: Triggers the execution of Flipando's Special App Generator, initiating a background job for application completion.
actions.runAppGenerator.props.inputs_dat: JSON string of key-value pairs for application input variables.
actions.runAppGenerator.props.is_new_app: Whether the new app to be created should be private or public.
